typography.instructions: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric data, headings, code snippets, and tree nodes to give a research-grade technical vibe. Ensure all labels are uppercase with wide letter spacing.

colors.instructions: Rely heavily on technical borders and structural grayscale. Avoid large gradient washes. Color is function: use #8B5CF6 (Purple) for ROOT, #4F46E5 (Indigo) for TOPIC, and #10B981 (Emerald) for CHUNK nodes in the RAPTOR tree. Headers and overlays MUST have a solid or blurred opaque background (e.g., bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md), NEVER fully transparent.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px borders (border-border/40) on items. Use sharp 0px or 4px (rounded-sm) radiuses.
visual_enhancers.effects: Use high-contrast data display. Use mono-spaced font layouts for stats.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid soft glassmorphism for data panels; use solid dark backgrounds with strict borders for data clarity. For fixed headers, use heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/90).

grids_layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use all vertical space.
grids_layouts.tree_view: Full bleed container with controls absolutely positioned in corners.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous inner padding for structural elements (p-6, p-8) to avoid text collision with borders.

raptor_tree.instructions: Build an SVG-based interactive tree or node map. Use <svg> for bezier-curve connector lines (stroke-zinc-800). Use framer-motion for node entry animations (scale-up). Each node displays context upon hover/click. Nodes color-coded: Root(Purple), Topic(Indigo), Chunk(Emerald).

query_interface.instructions: Chat-style UI with a prominent Token Budget Bar at the top or bottom. The token bar must visually show the reduction % (e.g., standard context vs RAPTOR retrieved context).

stat_cards.instructions: Cardless style or flat rectangular cards with 1px zinc-800 borders, no shadow. Big mono numbers, small uppercase tracking labels.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons (translate-y-[1px], border brightness increase).
motion.transitions: Specific transitions only (e.g., transition-colors duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.tree_animations: Staggered entrance for tree nodes using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within accent-colored nodes, meets APCA/WCAG standards (use black text inside bright Emerald nodes if they are filled, or use outline styles with bright text).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with crisp, minimal implementation. Set strokeWidth={1.5} for a precise technical feel. Do NOT use emojis.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-tech AI memory developer tool. The aesthetic must be brutalist, data-first, and highly structured.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all numbers, metrics, and headers. Use IBM Plex Sans for body copy.
In the RAPTOR tree SVG, ensure paths use smooth bezier curves (d="M... C...") for elegance, contrasting the sharp UI.
The Token Bar must clearly indicate saved tokens vs budget. Use Shadcn Progress or custom divs with the emerald/indigo accent colors.
Do not center-align paragraphs. Everything should be left-aligned for data readability.
Do not add emojis to icons or text.
Use exact colors provided: Root (#8B5CF6), Topic (#4F46E5), Chunk (#10B981). Do not use the forbidden #7351B7.
DO NOT use App.css to center text (text-align: center). Keep layout alignment structural.
All components must be written in .js (React JS), not TypeScript.
Apply data-testid to all actionable components (buttons, links, form inputs) and important stats.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
